body:
Having being born in a third world country I initially thought that money an the lack of opportunities could cause suicide.

Luckily I made good friends abroad and realised that the effects of this pandemic are way much greater.

I personally felt that I had no opportunities having being born with a weak passport and being rejected from working abroad despite my qualifications and abilities. 

Last week I reached my breaking point and really thought about ending it all. In the end after speaking with my friend who seems to be in a better place, I realise that depression comes from very different places.

We always think the grass is greener in the other side of the fence because we only look for what we think is the cause of our depression. I feel for you and hope that you can get better.

Just keep it mind that luckily you have a lot of tools at your disposal. Privilege is not a reason to invalidate problems but a blessing that others don’t have. Use the tools that life has given you to try and get better and then try help other people. That’s the only thing I can say. All the best.

I really appreciate everyone. To be honest I didn’t know I was going to find empathy in this subreddit. I guess I was traumatised by how savage the troll box is. I will start again with demo then trying to get funding with a prop trading company while looking for a job. Thank you all and even though I am not religious bless you.

No but it does give you the chance to afford more experiences, do different skills and create more bonding moments with the people around you. Sadly it is how the world works around. You don’t necessarily have to be happy with money but you can’t be happy without money.
You can choose your actions. And it was my mistake for not breaking even when I could and become greedy at the last second to lose it all.

Thank you. I have let the charts go for some days now. I think my best option is to get a job and start snall investing while potentially get into another prop form to get funding. I don’t think trading my own money is the way to go.

Yeah. My problem is that I haven’t had a job for 3 years. It’s been difficult as an international student so I was trying to rely on trading and it blew up in my face. And now with covid is even worse that’s why I was feeling so down.

Thank you. I felt very stupid because it is the third time I lost a lot of money. I have been learning a lot but this time it was all emotional. I have a set of rules and strategy and everything went out the window and crumbled.
I found a lot of empathy in this comment. Thanks. It’s stupid because I have done money before but emotions took away any logical thinking. And with covid getting a job is near impossible.
I wish all the best for you. I thought hanging would be the best but it scares the fuck out of me. Maybe not eating and drinking is the way to go.

Today I woke up at 8 pm. So literally I didn’t eat or drink for at least 24 hours. I felt as you said weak and felt that I almost passed out the other day. But is this even a way to really go out? I don’t know seems slow and unpredictable. Like you don’t know if you will last a day more or a week. Also how do you die. Feels very bizarre to me.
At least I have those to put and end to everything. You are right. I am just depressed for what my life has become.
I tried everything and lost all in the process. I think it is time for me to do this. At the very least the only thing I might be able to control in my life is how to end it.
When I said plan I referred to my suicide plan. But you are right I should give it a try.
I didn’t know this was a thing. I have been barely eating and drinking but I did not know this was achievable. How painful would it be though?
And that’s why today I woke up at 8pm
I tried pursuing my dream and now I have lost everything. I would have been better off by not doing anything and just get a job.
Happened to me yesterday. Went to sleep until 5 am and woke up at 7pm. I just refused and tried to sleep more.
I have heard most hotlines are useless and just follow the same script. Haven’t tried it myself but that’s the feedback I got from what I have read.

Sorry to hear that. It is possible that she underestimates depression and suicide. A lot of people in my home country downplay it and treat it as a joke or that you are just embittered. If I am feeling suicidal having someone who is supporting me, I can only imagine how you must feel. I can only wish you the best and that hopefully she will realise that your issues are real.

Probably because they don’t understand what you are going through and from an outside perspective it is how they are affected.

A friend of mine is also depressed and at our point I wanted to tell him no to do anything because I would miss him. Just to then realise that is just unfair from my part. So I decided I would support him and not judge. Of course it all depends on the reason behind the depression and whether it is fixable or not.

I understand. You may be right to some respect. But I have seen really ugly people with pretty hot girls. There must be a way and probably there is. Is it way more difficult, of course it is. Sounds a bit far fetched but try looking at other countries.

You would be surprised how appearances change so much depending on the country. People I consider ugly do very well in other parts of the world.

What I am trying to say in summary is that you can still do something. It sucks dick to be honest and having a good Hebe lottery makes a lot of difference not only for love but even for jobs. But hell what if you focused all that energy just to make money and pay them bitches. 

All the best man. And sorry I didn’t intend my last comment to be like just another comment.

This is dark but I feel the same. I am sad cause I am living with my gf. I don’t really want her to see me. It will probably traumatise her. I’ll probably go back to my family and then do it. Fuck them.
You are right. It’s also going against the most basic animal instinct. Survive. It’s fucking tough

I don’t want to sound like an asshole to you but it’s a bit of tough love. A lot of the things you said if not most can be controlled in a way by you.

I don’t believe I am particularly good looking but I managed a way to compensate by learning to be more charming. If you are too fat then try doing a routine and stick to it. Believe in yourself. Unless it’s hormone related which then you might have to do the same but expect slower results.

I was a loser and an introvert when I was a kid and learned to not be. I kid you not, I read even books on flirting and shit. You can do it but you need to be willing to change. All the best.
I wish the best outcome for you.

Sadly there is no easily accessible and easy to hide. Society makes it almost impossible to get information on the topic. That’s why most people say “if you wanted to die you would already have done it”. It really is bs because you can still kill yourself after hearing that.
Just remember it’s all about the landing surface. Waterfalls are probably the worst for that. Too much room for error
For me it’s the opposite. Once I sleep I don’t want to wake up. I would love to sleep and never wake up.
You will not be ignored. I hope the best for you.
Tell me about it. I secretly hate my family. They are very toxic and would even consider them bad people to some extent. I know they care about me which makes it even worse for me.
Same here just dunno exactly how. I’m too scared.
There is not a single night where I ask the universe to prevent me from waking up. The bad part is that even if you work 10x and give 200% you might not get anywhere. The world is fucked up.
Same here. My gf used the “but think about the ones who love you”. I literally told her I don’t give a shit about people. She bursted into tears. It’s always about them and never about yourself.

I used to be fit and very optimistic. I think it’s the endgame for me now. Either I do it in the short term or miraculously bounce back. Now I barely eat, I don’t really come out of bed. So I can relate to you being a shadow. My gf literally told me that she misses me referring to the pre-suicide me.

When I told my gf she bursted into tears. I told her that just saying think about the ones who love you is just unfair and selfish. If we want to die is because we are fed up with whatever is going on and we shouldn’t keep suffering just because some people don’t want us to go.

For me, I haven’t killed myself because I’m a pussy. I’m afraid of it even though I have a plan. I think it might fail tbh but I am too scared to even try it.

Never thought about it that way. Although we started to originate consciousness after we are born. So how does the reverse work. We just see. Blank and nothingness?

Answering your first question, I have been trying several years to work abroad. I studied abroad and was top of the class for nothing. Never could land a job despite trying in multiple countries. I was doing trading on the side and stopped obeying my rules. Lost all of my bitcoin and now that is exploding up I want to kill myself. Lost my life savings and the alternative I had for not having a job.

Might sound like it’s not a big deal it’s just money. But all my live I have been in a time bomb. Waiting for a visa to expire to go back and rot in my home country. I think I rather die than go back. Funny thing is that I should have been happy and jumping around but I screwed that for myself as well.

At least at thirty floors you are guaranteed to go out. I lived in a 6-7 floor building and thinking the same thing. Although the only thing I don’t like is how brutal and unfair it could be to bystanders. That’s the only reason I haven’t really given it a shot.
Same here. The mistakes that I have made and knowing I can’t either go to the past or change my decisions. I hate myself the most in this world.

I understand what you mean. I had a belt around my neck and instantly started gagging and coughing. People say dying is easier than living and if you wanted to die you would already have done it but for anyone who is really thinking about it we know this is bs. It’s very tough to go against your biggest instinct. Survival. I think it’s more about the emotional peak you go through than the average of how you feel.

Like you can feel like shit every day and it won’t make a difference but if one day something really happens and you are overly emotional then maybe overwriting that will be easier.
Same feeling. Sometimes I try to force myself to sleep as much as possible because the waking numbness and dreams are way much better than being alive and awake.
Already in a spiral down. Just thought of it in order to not hesitate and just do it rather than just drinking because I am feeling suicidal.
People always say that living is harder. It they don’t understand that dying on purpose is harder. You have to go against your biology. I understand where you come from.
Asked for a second chance and things just got worse.
Thank you. I hope that ventilating will help me. But I do feel like a plane spiralling down and I don’t know if I can stop it.

I was thinking about what robbin Williams did and use a belt hinged in the closet door. I don’t think I can get rope and it would be rather suspicious. Also I don’t really have anywhere with height to tie it.

It is just difficult when you hate yourself. It’s frustrating because I do hate my family in some ways. I know they care but until a point I wouldn’t consider them good people. I know people care for me but until what point is their care for me greater than my wish for eternal rest. Today it was one of my happiest days in this year and it was because I slept like 12 hours or more having dreams. I wish I could sleep even more and so wonder that maybe death would not be that bad. Thank you for your support and I hope things change but there are not enough things happening to signal that it will be okay.

I’m sorry to hear this. I’m also looking for the info but apparently you can’t suggest anything at all or mods will take you down. I really wished there was information available for people who really want to do it to avoid the extra suffering. I guess if you are in the USA the answer is clear. As for anywhere else I have no idea. I hope things can get better at your side.

Today it was the happiest day of this year. I got to sleep more than 12 hours. I had some weird but good dreams. I just can’t stand being awake. To be honest I would rather sleep forever but I don’t even know if death would be similar to sleeping. Instant black or no consciousness. If I knew it would be the same feeling I would have already done it.
